headline:
the supply story is *almost over*.
the rest takes longer than the start.

panes.title: SUPPLY ALREADY ISSUED
panes.sub: share of the maximum, measured today

panes.title: WHAT IS LEFT
lines: 1,071,300,900 KAS are still unmined. that is *3.73 percent* of the maximum.
at the current schedule 99 percent is reached in june 2028. what comes after keeps halving every twelve months.

note: emission halves every twelve months, so the remaining amount is a shrinking series and never quite reaches the maximum.

post.x: 96.27 percent of every KAS that will ever exist is already mined. 1,071,300,900 KAS are still to come, and 99 percent is reached in june 2028 at the current schedule. what comes after keeps halving every twelve months.
